description: A registry source lists a validly-signed sealed artifact under an index entry that claims a DIFFERENT identity: the entry says acme/weather-widget@2.0.0, and the artifact it points at carries a genuine, correctly-anchored MKT-009a envelope signing acme/legacy-widget@1.0.0. Every check that exists without MKT-040a passes — the entry's CHI-021 digest matches the bytes served, the envelope's content digest matches the extracted entry set, and the signing key is anchored for the acme namespace — so the host would install a pack whose identity is not the one the reference, the install record (MKT-094), the channel pointer (MKT-046) and the resolved-version high-water mark (MKT-050) were all keyed on. MKT-040a refuses the resolution outright: the signed identity is authoritative, the entry's claim is what is being checked, and neither identity is installed.

expected.rationale: the entry's claimed (artifact_id, kind, version) must equal the envelope's signed identity; a digest match binds bytes to an entry but never binds an identity to it
